critique.title: Transitioning ToDo to JSON (md/wedo/ => json/wedo/)
pros: Metadata Richness: Non-noisy attachment of timestamps and dependency IDs.
cons: HUD Complexity: Reliance on formatter scripts.
Constraint vs Creativity: Rigid schema vs free-form Markdown.
critique.recommendation: Treat JSON as part of the Runtime Nervous System. Implement 'Print Protocol' interface.
